instruction: Open the online check-in page for United Airlines flights.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to navigate from United Airlines homepage to the check-in page. Uses existing evaluator functions (is_expected_url_pattern_match metric + active_tab_info getter) to verify the active tab URL matches the expected check-in page pattern. Similar difficulty to original baggage fee task - requires one main navigation action from homepage.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: navigating to United Airlines check-in page
Data flow is correct: get_active_tab_info returns dict with 'url' field, is_expected_url_pattern_match handles dict format properly
Metric logic is sound: uses regex search to match URL pattern against active tab URL
Expected value is accurate: 'united.com/en/us/fly/travel/check-in' correctly identifies the check-in page
No parameter handling errors: metric correctly accesses rules['expected'] directly when type='rule'
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the only requirement in the instruction (reaching check-in page URL)
